exchange_rates.note: LKR per 1 unit of foreign currency, from the LKR base. Converted prices are rounded to the nearest 5 LKR.

price_verification: Every SOURCE row was priced from a page that was actually downloaded (JSON-LD offers, product:price meta, or a Shopify products.json variant). No search-engine snippet was used.

products.name: Ruffwear Front Range Lightweight Dog Leash
products.description: A lightweight everyday walking leash with a padded handle and a clip that can be attached to a collar or harness. Shown in blaze orange, one of several colour options the brand sells, and part of the Front Range line of walking gear.
products.image_alt: Ruffwear Front Range dog leash in blaze orange
products.notes: Variant priced: New / Blaze Orange (colour code 850), sku 40753-850.

products.name: KONG Retractable Leash Ultimate
products.description: A retractable leash from the brand that makes the classic red rubber toy, with a soft grip handle and a locking button for shorter control on walks. Shown in red, the size offered on the official store's product page.
products.image_alt: KONG red retractable leash with soft grip handle
products.notes: SUBSTITUTE for 'KONG Reflective Retractable Leash' - KONG does not make a reflective retractable leash. Approved by Ashan 2026-09-27. Pack shot is only 450x450/29 KB because the size is baked into KONG's own file name; no larger file is published.

products.name: Flexi Classic M Cord Retractable Leash, 16 ft / 5 m
products.description: A cord-style retractable leash that extends and rewinds with a press of the button, in the medium size with a five metre cord. Shown in red, a colour the brand lists for the Classic cord range.
products.image_alt: Red Flexi Classic M retractable cord leash
products.notes: Variant priced: Classic M Cord 16 ft / 5 m. EUR rate 377.78617 LKR applied.

products.name: Zee.Dog Classic Airleash Retractable Leash
products.description: A short retractable leash with a shock absorbing section built into the cord, from a brand that designs and tests its own dog gear. The 3.3 foot version is the compact one in the Airleash range.
products.notes: Variant priced: 3.3 ft, sku 390279. Published name contains a pipe character; stored as 'Classic Airleash'.

products.name: PetSafe Nylon Dog Leash, 4 ft
products.description: A plain nylon leash in the everyday four foot length, three quarters of an inch wide, with a clip at each end for attaching to a collar or harness. Shown in black, from a brand known for training and containment products.
products.image_alt: Black PetSafe nylon dog leash, 4 ft by 3/4 inch
products.notes: petsafe.com only serves products behind /p/<handle>/<SKU>/; /products.json, /sitemap.xml and /collections/* are 404. PetSafe's real SKU contains slashes (LSH-3/4-X-4-BLK), which the products.sku column rejects, so it is stored with hyphens.

products.name: Rogz Utility Classic Dog Lead
products.description: A padded handle lead for general walking, offered in a medium size and shown in black. The Utility Classic is the everyday lead in the brand's range, aimed at owners who walk the same route with a collar or harness.
products.image_alt: Rogz Utility Classic lead in black
products.notes: Variant priced: Black / M, sku HL11A. AUD rate 233.75409 LKR applied.

products.name: LupinePet Eco Recycled Dog Leash
products.description: A leash made from recycled webbing with a padded handle, in the four foot length and half inch width, shown in a two tone sea colour. Part of an eco range from a brand that makes most of its gear in the United States.
products.image_alt: LupinePet eco recycled dog leash in two tone recycled webbing
products.notes: Variant priced: 1/2 in wide / Tropical Sea / 4 ft, sku 36338.

products.name: Roverlund Leader-of-the-Pack Leash
products.description: A leash built with double sewn climbing rope and a padded grip, from a brand that makes dog walking gear for city use. Shown in the yellow and black colourway, in the classic climbing rope style.
products.image_alt: Roverlund Leader-of-the-Pack leash in yellow and black
products.notes: SUBSTITUTE for 'Frisco Reflective Nylon Leash' - Frisco is a Target house brand that 403s on every path and header set. Approved by Ashan 2026-09-27. Variant priced: YELLOW / BLACK, sku 11088, currency confirmed USD via JSON-LD.

products.name: Max and Neo 6 ft Reflective Nylon Dog Leash
products.description: A six foot nylon leash with a reflective stripe, made for visibility in low light on walks. Shown in black, and one of several lengths the brand sells in this reflective style.
products.image_alt: Max and Neo black 6 ft nylon reflective dog leash
products.notes: Variant priced: 6 ft x 1 in wide, black, sku rgleash-black-6x1.

products.name: PAWORA Everyday Walking Leash
products.description: Our own everyday walking leash, made for short trips around the block and for puppies still learning to walk beside a handler. It has a padded grip, a clip at each end and a simple woven body in our house green.
products.notes: Fictional PAWORA house product kept deliberately at Ashan's instruction 2026-09-27. Demo price, no source URL, placeholder image.
